download_mvs_synth_dataset: run the MVS-Synth dataset download script to a target directory with parallel workers
download_mvs_synth_only: run the download script with --download-only to fetch the MVS-Synth dataset without extracting
extract_mvs_synth_archives: run the download script with --extract-only to extract downloaded MVS-Synth tar archives
download_and_extract_mvs_synth: run the MVS-Synth download script to download and extract the dataset in one step
download_mvs_synth_parallel: run the MVS-Synth download script with multiple workers for faster parallel downloading
